subject: Activation Compass: MAP & draft timeline for NexaHealth
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12 -0800
Subject: Activation Compass: MAP & draft timeline for NexaHealth

Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a companion draft SOW so your procurement team can start the review. High level proposal below — this is staged so we can hit a soft-launch within the quarter while giving your security and procurement teams time to finish the formalities.

Top-line milestones (draft):
- Kickoff + requirements capture — Nov 29, 2026 (2 hr) — Redwood PM + NexaHealth stakeholders
- Integration sprint (prefix caching + routing) — Dec 6–17, 2026 — Redwood Eng + Nexa infra lead
- Data validation and QA — Dec 20–24, 2026 — NexaHealth QA + Redwood CS
- Soft go-live (beta) — Jan 4, 2027 — limited traffic; monitoring & rollback plan active
- Full production launch — Jan 18, 2027 — handoff complete, success metrics live

Initial ownership (draft):
- Redwood PM: Michael Grant (me) — MAP owner, status reporting
- Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole — onboarding, playbooks, customer training
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Ben Carter — integration support and runbooks
- NexaHealth technical lead: Jordan Pierce — test data, validation, UAT sign-off

Requests / next steps:
1) Jordan — please confirm whether the kickoff week (Nov 29) works for your team and whether Procurement needs any additional SOW fields beyond the attached.
2) Procurement — if you want a separate channel, cc your procurement inbox and we’ll route SOW & commercial details there.
3) Internal team — Marissa / Ben / Priyom, please review the draft MAP attached and flag anything you want adjusted before I share the final version with Nexa.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestone owners), SOW_NexaHealth_draft_v2.pdf (commercial + terms, draft)

Thanks — aiming to lock dates this week so we can book the kickoff and reserve capacity.

—
Michael Grant
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nexahealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation Compass: MAP & draft timeline for NexaHealth

Michael —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Two quick items from our side:
1) Procurement will need the SOW to include our data residency clause and a reference to our standard SLAs; I copied procurement on this thread. They typically ask for a redline rather than a new doc — we can provide the redline by EOD Friday.
2) The proposed integration sprint looks tight for our internal infra team during Dec 6–17. Can we shift the integration window to Dec 13–31 and push the soft go-live to Jan 11, 2027? That gives our engineers room to close other year-end work.

If those changes are acceptable, I can confirm the Nov 29 kickoff and route procurement's redline.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
NexaHealth

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nexahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:20 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation Compass: MAP & draft timeline for NexaHealth

Team —

Jordan asked to shift the integration window + soft go-live a week later to accommodate Nexa's internal calendar. Updated draft timeline below (please pull the attached MAP v1 for owner matrix):
- Kickoff + requirements capture — Nov 29, 2026 (confirmed tentative) — Redwood PM + NexaHealth stakeholders
- Integration sprint — Dec 13–31, 2026 — Redwood Eng (Ben) to lead with Nexa infra
- Data validation and QA — Jan 3–7, 2027 — NexaHealth QA + Redwood CS (Marissa)
- Soft go-live (beta) — Jan 11, 2027 — limited traffic, 72-hr bridge monitoring
- Full production launch — Jan 25, 2027 — gated acceptance and SLA handover

Action items for internal owners (short):
- Ben Carter: scope integration tasks in the MAP (API contracts, auth, perf tests) and prepare runbooks by Dec 6.
- Marissa Cole: draft onboarding agenda, training materials, and 90-day success metrics; prep kickoff slide deck by Nov 24.
- Priyom Das: coordinate access & infra prerequisites (VPN, service accounts, KMS) and confirm our capacity profile with infra by Nov 20.
- Michael Grant (me): finalize MAP with updated dates and send final to Nexa once Ben/Marissa confirm availability.

Jordan / Procurement — we will await your redline on the SOW. Marissa and Ben expect to have materials ready for the kickoff if Nov 29 stays in place. If procurement requires doc changes that affect schedule (e.g., custom SLAs), flag ASAP so we can re-evaluate dates.

—
Michael
Principal Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Pierce <jordan.pierce@nexahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation Compass: MAP & draft timeline for NexaHealth

Thanks — I’ll own CS for Nexa and will run the kickoff and onboarding cadence. Quick commitments from my side:
- Kickoff (Nov 29) — I’ll schedule a 2-hr session and circulate the agenda by Nov 19.
- Training + enablement — two 90-min sessions during week of Jan 3 (recorded and slide deck saved to the shared Drive).
- Success metrics — I’ll propose the 90-day KPIs in the MAP and add measurement owners (eng + product contacts).
- Risk notes: if procurement requires SLA edits that alter monitoring/rollback responsibilities, we should expect a 1–2 week timeline slip; I’ll flag any impacts immediately.

Ben — can you confirm runbook availability by Dec 6? Priyom — confirm infra checklist items and whether you need a pre-kickoff sync with Nexa's infra lead.

Jordan — happy to meet during the week of Nov 22 for a pre-kickoff alignment if helpful. Otherwise I’ll proceed to schedule Nov 29 as tentative.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
